name: WdRectangleType
description: Specifies the type of rectangle and the information it contains.

constants.name: wdTextRectangle
constants.description: Represents a space occupied by text.

constants.name: wdShapeRectangle
constants.description: Represents a space occupied by a shape.

constants.name: wdMarkupRectangle
constants.description: Represents a space occupied by a comment balloon.

constants.name: wdMarkupRectangleButton
constants.description: Represents a space occupied by the more (...) indicator that appears in a comment balloon when there is additional text for the comment.

constants.name: wdPageBorderRectangle
constants.description: Represents a space occupied by a page border.

constants.name: wdLineBetweenColumnRectangle
constants.description: Represents a region corresponding to a line that separates columns.

constants.name: wdSelection
constants.description: Represents a space occupied by a selection tool, for example the table selection tool in the upper-left corner of a table or the anchor for an image.

constants.name: wdMarkupRectangleArea
constants.description: Represents space occupied for the presentation of revision balloons on the page. This space is only printed if you print using "Document Showing Markup" in the Print dialog box.

constants.name: wdReadingModeNavigation
constants.description: Represents space occupied by the page navigation buttons when reading a document in full page reading view.

constants.name: wdMarkupRectangleMoveMatch
constants.description: Represents space occupied by the Go button used to find matching pairs of tracked moves in a document.

constants.name: wdReadingModePanningArea
constants.description: Represents space occupied for page turning when reading a document in full page reading view.

constants.name: wdMailNavArea
constants.description: Represents space occupied by the email message navigation buttons when reading email in Microsoft Office Outlook.

constants.name: wdDocumentControlRectangle
constants.description: Represents space occupied by a content control, equation, or document building block in-document control.
